scientific_question: After hard-matching active camera count, does a direction-conditioned local-plus-global deployment-visible metric identify the 96-key Riesz-action target across complete PoolFire trajectories?
reason_for_new_gate: v145 closed one shared global camera-set neighborhood. Its post-result audit showed material cross-trajectory camera-count mixing, but same-trajectory neighborhoods already had more than 95 percent same-count edges and still failed. v146 therefore changes the representation in the smallest physically distinct way: camera count is matched exactly, each structural direction has its own local state, and global moments and observable-pose coupling are added as equal-weight blocks rather than allowed to dominate by dimensionality.

immutable_roster.stage_a_sentinels: reuse the frozen v143 one-per-trajectory-by-camera-count roster
immutable_roster.stage_b_full_trajectory_authorization: run all 3700 cells only if at least one cross-trajectory Stage-A method passes all 20 sentinels and all five four-sentinel trajectory tails
immutable_roster.teacher_target: validated v143 geometry-local block Riesz action
immutable_roster.direction_selector: reuse the target-blind v144 SHA256 structural-key selector

direction_local.definition: the v143 target-camera, peer-camera, pooled-camera, direction-observable and discrete-token design for the target-blind selected direction

global_moments.definition: active-camera mean and population standard deviation of all 45 per-camera deployment-visible features; camera-count one-hot is omitted because count is matched exactly

global_observable_pose_coupling.definition: flattened 27x18 active-camera cross-covariance between centered detector-observable features and centered reported-pose features

metric.camera_count_match: candidate camera count must exactly equal query camera count before any distance is evaluated
metric.outer_fit_whitening: for every held-out trajectory and camera count, global blocks use the 740 same-count fit samples; each direction-local block additionally conditions on the structural key
metric.block_distance: root mean squared standardized Euclidean distance over active dimensions
metric.combined_distance: square root of the arithmetic mean of squared block distances, so local, moments and pose-coupling blocks have equal total weight
metric.tie_break: distance, candidate sample index, candidate direction index

stage_a_methods.prediction_target: one target-blind selected Riesz-action scalar per candidate sample and structural key; the 96 predicted scalars form one sample target vector

decision_rule.count_mean_passes: Prefer the cheaper count-conditioned mean and close nonlinear direction-conditioned claims.
decision_rule.cross_global_method_passes: Record hard-count global-state sentinel headroom and require Stage B before any predictor.
decision_rule.cross_local_only_passes: Record direction-local sentinel headroom and require Stage B before any predictor.
decision_rule.cross_local_moments_passes_while_cheaper: Record local-plus-global-moment sentinel headroom and require Stage B before any predictor.
decision_rule.cross_local_pose_coupled_passes_while_ch: Record local-plus-observable-pose sentinel headroom and require Stage B before any predictor.
decision_rule.no_cross_method_passes_but_any_within_me: Close cross-trajectory transfer under the frozen metric; do not train a larger model.
decision_rule.no_cross_or_within_method_passes: Close the frozen hard-count direction-conditioned neighbor family; do not rescue it with GPU or a larger model.
decision_rule.execution_or_independent_recomputation_f: Inconclusive; preserve evidence and do not interpret partial arrays.
